activity_statements.statement: operates 10,900+ retail stores and eCommerce sites across 19 countries serving approximately 280 million customers and members each week
runs a global supply chain that moves more than 100 billion items per year supporting an everyday-low-price retail model
operates Sam's Club membership warehouse clubs offering curated grocery, fresh food and Member's Mark private-label products with Scan & Go, curbside pickup and home delivery
operates Walmart International retail and eCommerce businesses in 18 countries outside the US
employs technology and data platforms to run intelligent retail operations, omnichannel fulfillment and supply chain optimization for a people-led, tech-powered model
invested $350 billion in US-sourced goods supporting 750,000+ US jobs as part of its domestic supply sourcing strategy

name_reality_gap: Labeled Retail; activity evidence reveals Walmart is simultaneously one of the world's largest technology employers, a $100B+ annual logistics operator, and an emerging retail-media advertising platform — the retail label substantially undersells the tech and logistics reality.
extraction_notes: Good single authoritative source with quantified metrics. Walmart's tech arm (Walmart Global Tech) and retail media network (Walmart Connect) are significant but not fully detailed in this source.
